statement: A strongly regular graph is determined up to isomorphism by its parameters (n, k, lambda, mu); in particular any strongly regular graph with parameters (16, 6, 2, 2) is the 4x4 rook's graph.
definitions: A strongly regular graph with parameters (n,k,lambda,mu) is a k-regular simple graph on n vertices in which every two adjacent vertices have exactly lambda common neighbours and every two non-adjacent vertices have exactly mu; the 4x4 rook's graph is the Cartesian product K4 x K4 (cells of a 4x4 grid adjacent when in the same row or column).
